newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nadro wins Pemex hospitals contract.
newsitem.headline: Nadro wins Pemex hospitals contract.

text.p: Mexican pharmaceutical distributor Nadro SA de CV said it won a contract from state oil firm Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) to supply medicines to Pemex hospitals through the end of this year.

"On September 17 Nadro won a contact to supply Pemex in the fourth quarter of 1996 and supply pharmaceutical products worth a maximum 150 million pesos", Alfredo Romero, deputy director of investor relations, told Reuters.
The contract represents likely sales of 40 million pesos a month for Nadro, he added.
